meta.title: Teona Hotel | A City Stay in Central İzmit
meta.description: Teona Hotel in central İzmit offers 44 rooms across Economy, French, Suite, Triple and Twin types, plus Payidar Restaurant, a meeting room, fitness facilities and a sauna.

home.title: Close to the rhythm of the city, with time to unwind
home.subtitle: Since 2010, Teona Hotel has welcomed guests with 44 rooms and a range of facilities for a practical city stay.
home.introTitle: A comfortable city stay in central İzmit
home.introBody: With 44 rooms across five room types, Teona Hotel brings together Wi-Fi, parking, satellite TV, a fitness centre and a sauna for a comfortable city stay.
home.roomsTitle: Five room options for your stay
home.roomsBody: Economy, French, Suite, Triple and Twin rooms provide options for different bed arrangements and stay requirements.
home.economyBody: An ideal choice for guests seeking an economical and comfortable stay in the city centre.
home.frenchBody: A comfortable, restful stay with a double French-bed layout.
home.suiteBody: Extra comfort throughout your stay, with a spacious living area and private terrace.
home.tripleBody: A three-person bed layout suited to families and guests travelling together.
home.twinBody: A comfortable space for guests travelling together, with two separate beds.
home.amenitiesBody: Wi-Fi, parking, satellite TV, a fitness centre, a sauna and a meeting room with flexible seating arrangements are available at the hotel.
home.restaurantTitle: A place to meet within the hotel
home.restaurantBody: Payidar Traditional Restaurant hosts live music programmes and group events.
home.locationBody: Teona Hotel's central İzmit location offers a practical starting point for your time in the city.

economy.title: Economy Room
economy.meta: A practical choice for short city stays
economy.intro: The 15–20 m² Economy Room is designed for guests seeking an economical, simple and functional stay in central Izmit.
economy.detailTitle: Functional for city visits and business plans
economy.body1: Its compact layout provides a practical place to rest during short business trips, city visits or schedules that keep you out for most of the day. The Economy Room suits guests who value a straightforward stay and want to keep their accommodation budget under control.
economy.body2: Browse the room photographs from different angles, then enter your dates and guest details in the reservation bar. During your stay, you can use the hotel's free Wi-Fi and parking as well as satellite TV, the fitness centre and sauna.

french.title: French Room
french.intro: The 15–20 m² French Room offers an organised city stay for guests who prefer a double French bed.
french.body1: The French-bed layout provides a suitable accommodation area for two guests sharing a bed during a business or city visit to Izmit. Guests travelling alone who prefer a wider bed can also consider this 15–20 m² room category.
french.body2: The gallery shows the French Room's bed arrangement, furniture and different viewing angles. Choose your dates to continue to the reservation page, and use free Wi-Fi, parking, satellite TV, the fitness centre and sauna among the hotel's shared facilities during your stay.

suite.title: Suite Room
suite.intro: The 25 m² Suite Room and its terrace are prepared for guests who prefer a more spacious accommodation layout.
suite.detailTitle: A generous room layout and outdoor space
suite.body1: The wider layout allows the resting and accommodation areas to be used more comfortably within the same room. It is an alternative for guests planning a longer stay in Izmit, seeking more freedom of movement or expecting to spend part of the day at the hotel.
suite.body2: The Suite Room gallery presents both the interior and its terrace from several angles. Check available dates through the reservation bar, and enjoy shared hotel facilities including free Wi-Fi, parking, satellite TV, the fitness centre and sauna during your stay.

triple.title: Triple Room
triple.intro: The 15–20 m² Triple Room serves families and small groups with a bed layout suited to three guests.
triple.detailTitle: Suited to a three-person city stay
triple.body1: Designed for three guests who want to share the same room, this category simplifies room selection for family visits, trips with friends and short city plans. The gallery shows the 15–20 m² room and its bed placement from different angles; individual layouts may vary.
triple.body2: Select check-in and check-out dates and the number of adults and children to continue to current availability. During your stay, free Wi-Fi, parking, satellite TV, the fitness centre and sauna are available as shared hotel facilities.

twin.title: Twin Room
twin.meta: Two separate beds in one room
twin.intro: The 15–20 m² Twin Room offers a flexible stay for guests who want to share a room while using separate beds.
twin.body1: The two-bed layout suits colleagues travelling for business, friends sharing a trip or any two guests who prefer their own sleeping space. Its 15–20 m² area provides a functional accommodation arrangement for short business and city schedules in Izmit.
twin.body2: Use the Twin Room gallery to review the bed arrangement and different views, then select your stay dates in the reservation bar. Free Wi-Fi and parking, satellite TV, the fitness centre and sauna are available as shared hotel facilities throughout your stay.

about.title: In İzmit since 2010
about.lead: Teona Hotel serves guests in central İzmit with 44 rooms and a range of on-site facilities.
about.body1: The hotel's 44-room collection includes Economy, French, Suite, Triple and Twin room types.
about.body2: Teona Hotel has welcomed approximately 120,000 guests to date. The hotel is also home to Payidar Traditional Restaurant and a meeting room that can be adapted to different seating layouts.
about.principleTitle: A practical approach to city stays
about.principleBody: Wi-Fi, parking, satellite TV, a fitness centre and a sauna bring together the core facilities guests may need during their stay.
about.cityBody: Its central location makes Teona Hotel a practical accommodation option for business and city plans in İzmit.

items.question: Where is Teona Hotel located?
items.answer: Teona Hotel is located at Mehmet Ali Paşa Mahallesi, Bağdat Caddesi, Erkan Sokak No:3 in central İzmit.

items.question: What room types are available at the hotel?
items.answer: Teona Hotel has 44 rooms across five categories: Economy, French, Suite, Triple and Twin.

items.question: Which facilities can I use during my stay?
items.answer: The hotel offers Wi-Fi and parking as well as satellite television, a fitness centre and a sauna.

items.question: How can I make a reservation?
items.answer: Select your dates and guest details in the booking bar on the home page to continue to the live reservation system, or contact the hotel by telephone or email.

items.question: Which room type can I choose?
items.answer: Depending on your stay, you can choose an Economy, French, Suite, Triple or Twin room. Each room page includes its bed layout, floor area and photographs.

items.question: Which room has two separate beds?
items.answer: The Twin Room is arranged for two guests who prefer separate beds in the same room.

items.question: Which room is suitable for three guests?
items.answer: The Triple Room offers a bed arrangement suitable for three guests travelling together.

items.question: Is there a room with a terrace?
items.answer: The Suite Room has 25 m² of floor space and its own terrace.

sharedItems.question: Which hotel facilities are available with the room stay?
sharedItems.answer: During your stay, you can use the hotel's Wi-Fi and parking as well as satellite television, the fitness centre and sauna.

sharedItems.question: How can I check room availability?
sharedItems.answer: Select your check-in and check-out dates and the number of adults and children in the booking bar to continue to the live reservation system.

items.question: How large is the Economy Room?
items.answer: The Economy Room offers 15–20 m² of floor space.

items.question: Who is the Economy Room suitable for?
items.answer: The Economy Room is intended for guests seeking a practical and economical option for a short business trip or city stay.

items.question: What is the bed layout in the French Room?
items.answer: The French Room features a double French bed.

items.question: How large is the French Room?
items.answer: The French Room offers 15–20 m² of floor space.

items.question: How large is the Suite Room?
items.answer: The Suite Room offers 25 m² of floor space.

items.question: Does the Suite Room have a terrace?
items.answer: Yes. The Suite Room includes its own terrace.

items.question: Who is the Triple Room suitable for?
items.answer: The Triple Room is arranged for three guests, families or small groups who want to stay together.

items.question: How large is the Triple Room?
items.answer: The Triple Room offers 15–20 m² of floor space.

items.question: What is the bed layout in the Twin Room?
items.answer: The Twin Room is arranged for guests who prefer two separate beds in the same room.

items.question: How large is the Twin Room?
items.answer: The Twin Room offers 15–20 m² of floor space.

items.question: How can I contact Teona Hotel?
items.answer: You can reach the hotel on +90 262 325 95 95 or by email at info@teonahotel.com and callcenter@teonahotel.com.

items.question: What is the hotel's full address?
items.answer: Teona Hotel is at Mehmet Ali Paşa Mahallesi, Bağdat Caddesi, Erkan Sokak No:3, Bekirpaşa, İzmit / Kocaeli.

items.question: Where can I ask about a reservation?
items.answer: Use the booking bar to check availability, or contact the hotel directly through the call-centre email address for reservation and bed-layout information.

items.question: Does the hotel provide parking?
items.answer: Yes. Teona Hotel provides parking for its guests.

cookieConsent.title: Manage your cookie preferences
cookieConsent.bannerBody: Alongside necessary cookies, this site uses live support, analytics and marketing technologies only with your permission. Google Maps loads directly as an external service.
cookieConsent.settingsBody: You can manage live support, analytics and marketing separately. Google Maps loads directly as an external service. You can change your choices later from the footer.
cookieConsent.necessaryBody: Required for secure site operation and to remember your cookie choices for 180 days.
cookieConsent.liveSupportBody: Allows the Connexease chat service to load and lets you start a support conversation.
cookieConsent.externalMediaBody: Allows Google Maps content to load so you can view the location interactively.
cookieConsent.analyticsBody: Allows analytics tags in Google Tag Manager to measure how visitors use the site.
cookieConsent.marketingBody: Allows advertising measurement, retargeting and personalisation tags to operate.
cookieConsent.mapBlocked: Google Maps was not loaded because your external-content preference is disabled.

cookiePolicy.title: Cookie Policy
cookiePolicy.lead: This policy explains the necessary cookie and third-party services used on the Teona Hotel website and how those services are loaded.
cookiePolicy.managementBody: Necessary cookies are always active. Live support, analytics and marketing technologies operate only after you enable the relevant preference. You can change your choices at any time from the footer.
cookiePolicy.introBody: Cookies are small text files that may be stored in your browser when you visit a website. The Teona Hotel site uses a necessary first-party cookie to store your choices. Google Tag Manager communicates your consent state to relevant tags; Connexease live support loads only with permission, while Google Maps loads directly as an external service.
cookiePolicy.controllerBody: For processing activities carried out through cookies and similar technologies on this website, the data controller is Teona Hotel. You can contact us at the email address below with questions and requests concerning your rights under Türkiye's Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698.
cookiePolicy.necessaryBody: Used to operate the preference panel and remember your choices. This category cannot be disabled.
cookiePolicy.necessaryDetail: A first-party cookie named teona_cookie_consent stores your live support, analytics and marketing choices with the policy version for 180 days.
cookiePolicy.liveSupportBody: The Connexease live-chat service loads only after you enable the live-support preference.
cookiePolicy.liveSupportDetail: When loaded, Connexease may process your IP address, browser information and content you share during a chat.
cookiePolicy.mapsBody: Google Maps embeds load with the page independently of the cookie preference mechanism.
cookiePolicy.mapsDetail: When the map loads, your IP address and device or browser information may be sent to Google.
cookiePolicy.analyticsBody: Analytics tags managed through Google Tag Manager may measure site usage only when analytics permission is granted.
cookiePolicy.analyticsDetail: When permission is not granted, analytics_storage is communicated as denied.
cookiePolicy.marketingBody: Advertising measurement, personalisation and retargeting tags may operate only when marketing permission is granted.
cookiePolicy.marketingDetail: When permission is not granted, ad_storage, ad_user_data and ad_personalization are communicated as denied.
cookiePolicy.servicesBody: The following list describes the cookies and third-party services in the site's current technical setup.
cookiePolicy.providerControlled: Session-based or variable according to the provider's settings
cookiePolicy.tagManagerPurpose: Communicate consent status to tags and manage permitted measurement tags
cookiePolicy.mapsPurpose: Show the hotel location on an interactive map
cookiePolicy.providerNote: Connexease loads only with live-support permission. Google Tag Manager manages tag behaviour according to Consent Mode v2 states. Google Maps loads independently as an external service. Third-party providers may change the technologies they use and their retention periods.
cookiePolicy.rightsTitle: Withdrawing your choice and your rights
cookiePolicy.rightsBody: You can change or withdraw your permissions at any time through the Cookie preferences link in the footer. If you delete the teona_cookie_consent cookie in your browser, the preference panel will appear again on your next visit. Requests under Article 11 of Türkiye's Personal Data Protection Law may be submitted to Teona Hotel.
cookiePolicy.officialGuideBody: For more information about cookie practices, you can review the current guide published by Türkiye's Personal Data Protection Authority.
